column1: # Self-displaying C64 PRGs and PrintMaster, none of which RECOIL supports

column4: RECOIL rejects self-displaying PETSCII PRGs. Layout read from the SYS 2061 stub operands (copy loops from $0861/$0C49 to $0400/$D800, $D018 selects the ROM set, $D020/$D021 immediates) and checked on 1882 CSDb files. Output reviewed: PETSCII art with the right set, colours and background.
